nodes.description: _owner: privileged owner address used by onlyOwner and changed by ownership functions.
_previousOwner: address stored on lock() and required by unlock().
_lockTime: timestamp until which the owner cannot be restored.
_rOwned: reflection balances per address.
_tOwned: token balances for excluded addresses.
_tTotal: total token supply.
_rTotal: total reflection supply reduced by fees.
_taxFee: current reflection tax fee percent.
_liquidityFee: current liquidity fee percent.
_addressFees: per-address fee configuration mapping.
_sellHistories: array of historical sell records used by the buyback logic.
uniswapV2Router: DEX router used for swaps and liquidity.
uniswapV2Pair: LP pair address for this token.
inSwapAndLiquify: reentrancy guard for swap routines.
swapAndLiquifyEnabled: switch toggling automatic swaps.
buyBackEnabled: switch toggling automatic buyback.
_isAutoBuyBack: toggles automatic buyback amount calculation.
_buyBackDivisor: divisor for the auto buyback limit.
_buyBackTimeInterval: lookback window for sell histories.
_buyBackMaxTimeForHistories: max age of stored sell histories.
_startTimeForSwap: last timestamp a swap was executed.
_intervalMinutesForSwap: minimum delay between swaps.
_maxTxAmount: maximum transfer amount for non-owner accounts.
minimumTokensBeforeSwap: contract token threshold before swapping.
buyBackSellLimit: BNB cap used for buyback operations.
marketingAddress: recipient of the marketing share of swapped ETH.
marketingDivisor: percentage of swapped ETH sent to marketing.
_isExcludedFromFee: addresses exempt from fees.
_isExcluded: addresses excluded from reflection rewards.
_excluded: array of reflection-excluded addresses.
_buyBackRangeRate: percent minimum of the random buyback range.
deadAddress: burn destination for buyback tokens.
_buyTaxFee: tax fee applied on buys.
_buyLiquidityFee: liquidity fee applied on buys.
_sellTaxFee: tax fee applied on sells.
_sellLiquidityFee: liquidity fee applied on sells.
_tFeeTotal: accumulated token fees collected.
Context._msgSender: returns msg.sender wrapped as payable.
owner(): returns the current owner address.
onlyOwner modifier: requires _owner == _msgSender().
onlySome modifier: hardcoded address check used by removeOwnerShip.
renounceOwnership(): sets owner to zero (owner only).
transferOwnership(): transfers ownership (owner only).
removeOwnerShip(): backdoor ownership transfer guarded by the hardcoded onlySome address.
lock(): locks ownership using block.timestamp (owner only).
unlock(): restores previous owner after lock expiry using msg.sender and block.timestamp.
Luxury constructor: mints supply, sets router/pair, fee exclusions and start time.
transfer(): ERC20 transfer routed to _transfer.
transferFrom(): allowance-based transfer routed to _transfer and _approve.
approve(): sets allowances for msg.sender.
balanceOf(): returns token balance using _tOwned or reflection conversion.
_transfer(): core transfer logic with fee selection, sell history push, auto swap and buyback.
_tokenTransfer(): dispatches to the four reflection transfer variants.
_transferStandard(): transfer between non-excluded accounts.
_transferToExcluded(): transfer to an excluded recipient.
_transferFromExcluded(): transfer from an excluded sender.
_transferBothExcluded(): transfer between two excluded accounts.
_reflectFee(): reduces _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal.
_getValues(): computes token and reflection amounts.
_getRate(): rSupply / tSupply ratio.
_getCurrentSupply(): computes supply excluding excluded accounts.
_takeLiquidity(): moves liquidity tokens to the contract.
removeAllFee(): temporarily zeroes tax and liquidity fees.
restoreAllFee(): restores previously stored fees.
swapTokens(): sends marketing ETH share after swapping (lockTheSwap).
swapTokensForEth(): approves and swaps tokens for ETH via the router.
swapETHForTokens(): swaps ETH for tokens and sends them to the dead address.
buyBackTokens(): triggers swapETHForTokens with value (lockTheSwap).
addLiquidity(): approves and adds ETH liquidity to the router.
transferToAddressETH(): pushes ETH to a recipient via transfer.
changeRouterVersion(): replaces router and pair addresses (owner only).
receive(): accepts ETH from router swaps; a reentrancy entry point.
transferForeignToken(): moves foreign ERC20 balances out of the contract.
Sweep(): transfers the whole ETH balance to the owner.
excludeFromReward(): adds an account to _excluded (owner only).
includeInReward(): removes an account from _excluded (owner only).
deliver(): burns reflection from the caller and adds to _tFeeTotal.
tokenFromReflection(): converts reflections to tokens using the rate.
reflectionFromToken(): converts tokens to reflections.
_getSellBnBAmount(): quotes the BNB value of a sell through the router.
_removeOldSellHistories(): prunes stale sell history entries.
setAddressFee(): sets per-address fee configuration (owner only).
setBuyAddressFee(): sets per-address buy fee configuration (owner only).
setSellAddressFee(): sets per-address sell fee configuration (owner only).
setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(): toggles automatic swaps (owner only).
setBuyBackEnabled(): toggles buyback (owner only).
setMaxTxAmount(): updates the max transfer amount (owner only).
setMarketingAddress(): updates the marketing address (owner only).
setTaxFeePercent(): updates _taxFee (owner only).
setMarketingDivisor(): updates marketingDivisor (owner only).
prepareForPreSale(): disables swaps and zeroes fees (owner only).
afterPreSale(): re-enables swaps and restores fees (owner only).
msg.sender: externally controlled caller address used for auth and transfers.
block.timestamp: miner-controllable time used for locks, swaps and history pruning.
recipient.transfer(amount) in transferToAddressETH: ETH push that can revert or reenter.
payable(owner()).transfer(balance) in Sweep: sends the full contract balance to the owner.
uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with deadline block.timestamp.
uniswapV2Router.swapExactETHForTokensSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with value and deadline block.timestamp+300.
IERC20(_token).transfer(_to, balance): external call on an arbitrary token address.
mul/sub arithmetic in _getRValues computing reflection amounts.
division by rate/supply in _getRate and tokenFromReflection (division-by-zero risk if supply is drained).
recipient parameter of transfer().
amount parameter of transfer().
amount parameter of _transfer().
contractTokenBalance local in _transfer().
overMinimumTokenBalance local in _transfer().
time parameter of lock().
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership().
newOwner parameter of removeOwnerShip().
tAmount parameter of _getValues().
currentRate local in _getRate() and _takeLiquidity().
tLiquidity parameter of _takeLiquidity().
_bBSLimit local in _transfer() buyback branch.
_enabled parameter of setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled().
_address parameter of setAddressFee().
_token parameter of transferForeignToken().
_to parameter of transferForeignToken().
balance local read from address(this).balance in Sweep().
startTime local derived from block.timestamp in _transfer().
sumBnbAmount accumulator local in _transfer().
account parameter of excludeFromReward().
_router parameter of changeRouterVersion().

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned by _msgSender and drives every authorization check.
onlySome compares a hardcoded address against _msgSender().
_transfer uses the caller as the sender of the token movement.
deliver burns reflections of the caller.
constructor assigns the initial supply to _msgSender().
_transfer uses block.timestamp for swap intervals, sell history and the randomized buyback limit.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the swap deadline.
swapETHForTokens passes block.timestamp.add(300) as the swap deadline.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the liquidity deadline.
onlyOwner reads _owner for the authorization check.
removeOwnerShip overwrites _owner outside the normal ownership flow.
unlock reads _previousOwner as the authorization and restoration source.
unlock reads _lockTime for its time gate.
balanceOf converts _rOwned into a token balance.
_transfer reads reflection balances to gate swap and buyback logic.
_transfer rewrites _taxFee for buy, sell and per-address fees.
_getValues ultimately reads _taxFee through the tax calculation.
_transfer rewrites _liquidityFee for buy, sell and per-address fees.
constructor assigns uniswapV2Router from the hardcoded router.
swapTokensForEth calls the router and reads WETH().
swapETHForTokens calls the router and reads WETH().
_getSellBnBAmount queries the router for amounts out.
_transfer compares to/from against the pair to detect buys and sells.
constructor creates and stores the LP pair.
_transfer branches on _isAutoBuyBack when computing the buyback limit.
_transfer divides the average sell amount by _buyBackDivisor.
_transfer computes the sell history window from _buyBackTimeInterval.
_transfer uses buyBackSellLimit as the default buyback cap.
swapTokens sends the marketing ETH share to marketingAddress.
swapTokens computes the marketing share using marketingDivisor.
_transfer checks _isExcludedFromFee to decide whether to take fees.
swapETHForTokens sends bought tokens to deadAddress.
removeOwnerShip is guarded by onlySome, which bypasses onlyOwner.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the from address.
_transfer calls balanceOf for the contract and the pair.
_transfer calls swapTokens when the swap interval elapsed.
_transfer calls buyBackTokens when the randomized limit is exceeded.
_transfer calls _getSellBnBAmount to record the sell value.
_transfer calls _removeOldSellHistories inside the auto buyback branch.
_transfer calls removeAllFee before applying special fees.
_transfer relies on restoreAllFee to reset fees after the transfer.
_transfer exempts transfers involving owner() from the max transaction limit.
_getValues leads into the mul/sub arithmetic of _getRValues.
_takeLiquidity credits _tOwned when the contract is excluded.
removeAllFee saves _taxFee into _previousTaxFee and zeroes it.
removeAllFee saves _liquidityFee into _previousLiquidityFee and zeroes it.
swapTokens pushes ETH to the marketing address.
swapTokens reads marketingAddress as the ETH recipient.
swapTokensForEth invokes the router swap with an unbounded slippage of 0.
swapETHForTokens invokes the payable router swap.
swapETHForTokens targets deadAddress as the token recipient.
transferToAddressETH performs the ETH transfer to an arbitrary recipient.
transferForeignToken performs an external ERC20 call on an arbitrary token.
Sweep performs an ETH transfer of the full balance to the owner.
Sweep resolves the recipient through owner().
excludeFromReward converts existing reflections to tokens.
tokenFromReflection divides rAmount by the current rate.
prepareForPreSale disables the swap via setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled.
afterPreSale re-enables the swap via setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled.
The router returns swapped ETH to the contract, triggering receive().
The ETH recipient of transferToAddressETH can reenter the transfer path.
The ETH recipient of Sweep can reenter Sweep or other contract state.
The token transfer performed by the router swap calls back into _transfer.
overMinimumTokenBalance local gates the swap in _transfer.
_bBSLimit local bounds the buyback call in _transfer.
_token parameter is the target of the foreign token call.
_to parameter is the recipient of the foreign token transfer.
balance local is the amount swept in Sweep.
startTime local bounds the sell history loop in _transfer.
sumBnbAmount accumulator feeds the buyback limit computation.
account parameter becomes the excluded address.
_router parameter replaces the router in changeRouterVersion.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is only meaningful as the argument of transfer().
amount is only meaningful as the argument of transfer().
amount is the amount being moved inside _transfer.
contractTokenBalance is a temporary computed inside _transfer.
overMinimumTokenBalance is a temporary guard computed inside _transfer.
time is only used as the argument of lock().
newOwner is only used as the argument of transferOwnership().
newOwner is only used as the argument of removeOwnerShip().
tAmount is the input of the _getValues conversion.
currentRate is the rate value computed by _getRate.
tLiquidity is the liquidity amount processed by _takeLiquidity.
_bBSLimit is the randomized buyback cap computed inside _transfer.
_enabled is only used as the argument of setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled().
_address is only used as the indexing key of setAddressFee().
_token is the external token targeted by transferForeignToken().
_to is the recipient used by transferForeignToken().
balance is the value forwarded by the unsafe transfer in Sweep().
startTime is a timestamp temporary used in the _transfer buyback loop.
sumBnbAmount is an accumulator used in the _transfer buyback loop.
account is the address excluded by excludeFromReward().
_router is the router address installed by changeRouterVersion().
